rows.finding: Fresh checks covered scroll container geometry at 1440/1024/768/390px; CSS contains scroll-surface fade/wake behavior.
rows.nextAction: Exercise mouse, keyboard, touch scroll and verify idle fade plus exact CLI whitespace.
rows.limitation: scrollHeight/viewport assertions do not demonstrate scrollbar reveal, fade timing, touch, keyboard, or exact CLI text.

rows.finding: Fresh checks found no horizontal page/sidebar overflow at four viewport widths.
rows.nextAction: Run copy-exact long CLI line checks at desktop widths and inspect clipped code/raw output.
rows.limitation: copy-exact CLI behavior and all long-line rendering paths were not exercised.

rows.finding: Account menu opens and is keyboard reachable in the isolated browser fixture.
rows.nextAction: Verify the account entry has no visible caret and tab/keyboard order matches the acceptance path.
rows.limitation: No explicit caret/style assertion was made.

rows.finding: Fresh launch showed the selected Firewall profile identity.
rows.nextAction: Exercise firewall-profile open, rename synchronization, and profile/docs links.
rows.limitation: Profile open, rename synchronization, and docs interactions were not tested.

rows.finding: Reaction row opened from a rendered message in the isolated browser.
rows.nextAction: Verify reference row geometry, keyboard activation, and clipping at narrow widths.
rows.limitation: Fresh check did not measure clipping or keyboard activation.

rows.finding: Selecting reaction A then B left B selected and the result survived reload.
rows.nextAction: Test selecting the already-selected reaction clears it and verify messages remain intact after each transition.
rows.limitation: The clear-on-second-selection branch was not exercised.

rows.finding: A new user can enter a named conversation directly from the initial surface.
rows.nextAction: Exercise new conversation, existing chats, drafts, queues, and avatar access from the same entry path.
rows.limitation: The full coworker-first breadth of entry points was not exercised.

rows.finding: A short first message did not replace the Firewall coworker identity in the fresh render.
rows.nextAction: Keep a regression check for header identity on short and long first messages.
rows.limitation: Verified only the tested initial chat path.

rows.finding: Sidebar preview reduced markdown table/code-fence syntax to a compact text preview.
rows.nextAction: Open the full-title affordance and verify very long titles/previews remain accessible at narrow widths.
rows.limitation: Full-title access and all row-size extremes were not exercised.

rows.finding: One conversation could be pinned and remained pinned after reload.
rows.nextAction: Test multiple pinned conversations, ordering, and unpin/reload transitions.
rows.limitation: Ordering with multiple pinned items was not demonstrated.

rows.finding: Renaming a conversation changed the active coworker header to the conversation title.
rows.nextAction: Keep conversation title and coworker/profile identity as separate render fields when saving a rename.
rows.limitation: Reproduced in the controlled fixture; no external services were involved.

rows.finding: The sidebar presents direct chats and conversations as distinct grouped entries.
rows.nextAction: Verify grouping cannot imply coordinated execution and that old histories remain discoverable.
rows.limitation: No exhaustive old-history or execution-implication interaction was run.

rows.finding: Fresh check collapsed the rail while leaving the active chat surface present.
rows.nextAction: Exercise resize widths and type/send in the composer while collapsed.
rows.limitation: Resize and composer usability while collapsed were not demonstrated.

rows.finding: Back navigation returned to the prior chat with its draft, and forward navigation remained available in the corrected rerun.
rows.nextAction: Verify browser back/forward never drops drafts or starts a request across more navigation sequences.
rows.limitation: The run used one short sequence and did not prove execution non-duplication under navigation.

rows.finding: Workspace search returned the known saved phrase in the expected conversation result.
rows.nextAction: Open the result and verify exact conversation context and keyboard navigation.
rows.limitation: Result activation/context verification was not included.

rows.finding: Coworker filtering returned the matching coworker result in the isolated workspace search.
rows.nextAction: Exercise conversation filtering and assert exact result context for duplicate terms.
rows.limitation: Conversation filter and duplicate-result disambiguation were not tested.

rows.finding: Repeated-term find counted the expected matches while preserving the draft in the corrected harness.
rows.nextAction: Visit every match with next/previous controls and verify selection/focus stays in the conversation.
rows.limitation: The fresh assertion counted matches; it did not complete every visit or focus transition.

rows.finding: Escape from the command palette restored focus to its opener in the corrected rerun.
rows.nextAction: Invoke a selected action in the current chat and test keyboard traversal of the palette.
rows.limitation: Action execution and complete keyboard traversal were not exercised.

rows.finding: Empty send was disabled and multiline text could be entered/sent without an extra request in the controlled fixture.
rows.nextAction: Run a real IME composition sequence and verify Enter behavior during composition.
rows.limitation: IME composition was not simulated.

rows.finding: Draft retention code exists for chat navigation and persistence, but the two-chat switch/reload acceptance was not freshly exercised.
rows.nextAction: Create distinct unsent drafts in two chats, switch repeatedly, reload, and compare exact text.
rows.limitation: No fresh end-to-end evidence for independent drafts.

rows.finding: Supported file selection produced a labeled attachment-ready state.
rows.nextAction: Send the attachment through the mock backend and assert its contents reach model context; test unsupported labeling before send.
rows.limitation: Fresh check did not inspect request context or unsupported-file pre-send behavior.

rows.finding: Unsupported selection was rejected while a valid selection could be recovered in the isolated fixture.
rows.nextAction: Exercise one-file drag/drop and clipboard paste, then invalid-type recovery without duplicate attachments.
rows.limitation: Drag/drop and clipboard paths were not exercised.

rows.finding: No stable file/device mention resolver or unavailable-device filtering is implemented in the current UI path.
rows.nextAction: Implement and test stable IDs plus disconnected-device handling behind the mock boundary.
rows.limitation: No provider, device, or credential calls were made by this audit.

rows.finding: Reply-to-message identified the source and cancel removed the reference while retaining the draft.
rows.nextAction: Retain this check and add keyboard/source rendering coverage if the reply UI changes.
rows.limitation: Verified the tested single-message mouse path.

rows.finding: Edit/resend opened a reviewable dialog and the edited text was present in the controlled request payload.
rows.nextAction: Test edited prior messages that contain device commands and verify no prior command is silently repeated or reversed.
rows.limitation: No device command execution was permitted or tested.

rows.finding: No voice dictation implementation or editable transcript path was found.
rows.nextAction: Add a mocked recording/transcript flow with cancel and edit states.
rows.limitation: Microphone/device APIs were intentionally not called.

rows.finding: The composer exposes a fixed model note and send flow; no model/effort picker or request/response provenance selection is implemented.
rows.nextAction: Add picker state and assert selected model/effort plus response provenance in mock requests.
rows.limitation: No real provider call was attempted.

rows.finding: A backend-shaped streamed fixture rendered one final response with one activity/evidence panel and terminal output, without duplicate final text.
rows.nextAction: Add failure/end ordering and repeated-stream reconnection cases.
rows.limitation: The stream was locally fulfilled; provider behavior and reconnects were not tested.

rows.finding: Stop against the controlled running fixture left the run incomplete/UNKNOWN rather than claiming completion.
rows.nextAction: Keep cancellation-state regression coverage and add interrupted-tool evidence cases.
rows.limitation: No real remote request or device command was stopped.

rows.finding: A queued follow-up remained visible after reload in the isolated browser.
rows.nextAction: Dispatch two queued follow-ups and assert FIFO order with exactly-once submission.
rows.limitation: Order and duplicate-submission behavior were not freshly exercised.

rows.finding: Queue edit and remove operations updated the selected item in the corrected rerun.
rows.nextAction: Reload and intentionally resume a queued item, asserting only the selected item dispatches once.
rows.limitation: Resume and exactly-once dispatch were not tested.

rows.finding: Fresh unit tests verified steering authorization, before-model application, and one-time drain; the UI correction-before-next-tool path was not exercised.
rows.nextAction: Drive a UI steering correction while a mock run pauses before its next tool and assert no duplicate run.
rows.limitation: Unit coverage does not prove the browser UI flow.

rows.finding: No clarification/approval card renderer or stale-card authorization guard is present in the current UI path.
rows.nextAction: Add one-pending-question card mapping and stale-token rejection tests.
rows.limitation: No external approval or device action was invoked.

rows.finding: Plan mode was sent with the expected mode/scope in the controlled request, and no browser state change was observed in that scenario.
rows.nextAction: Use a malicious/tool-bearing plan fixture and assert the backend refuses state-changing execution.
rows.limitation: The current fixture did not prove backend no-tools enforcement for every plan request.

rows.finding: The corrected rerun displayed distinct backend-shaped tool_start/tool_result entries plus terminal metadata in the opened activity details.
rows.nextAction: Add an explicit raw-versus-result assertion with redacted/untrusted source fields.
rows.limitation: The audit used local fixtures and did not validate a live provider event stream.

rows.finding: Stopped and failed fixture states did not show a completed-success state; run-state code defines failure precedence and unknown recovery.
rows.nextAction: Measure elapsed time before/during/after a real mock delay and assert it stops on failure/interruption.
rows.limitation: Elapsed timing itself was not asserted by the fresh harness.

rows.finding: The UI globally blocks a second chat request and the backend uses a single chatPending guard, so isolated parallel visibility/stoppability is not implemented.
rows.nextAction: Replace global serialization with per-run state and test two isolated mock runs with independent stop/recovery.
rows.limitation: No concurrent provider/device calls were made.

rows.finding: Fresh response provenance displayed model and token information and context disclosure was available.
rows.nextAction: Exercise unavailable usage values and assert unknown is shown as unavailable rather than zero; compare request model to response model.
rows.limitation: Unknown-usage branch and model-mismatch case were not tested.

rows.finding: A failed run retained partial tool evidence, but the current UI has no retry control/review receipt after tool events; this is a missing feature in the exercised slice.
rows.nextAction: Add a retry control after partial failure that requires explicit review/intent and preserves prior evidence before dispatch.
rows.limitation: The controlled fixture did not demonstrate unsafe execution or repeat a completed device action.

rows.finding: Isolated restart/recovery checks recovered interrupted journal state without issuing a duplicate API request; recovery marks the run unknown.
rows.nextAction: Run packaged-app restart/recovery evidence when that environment is available.
rows.limitation: This was an isolated browser/journal simulation, not a process crash of the packaged app.

tests.result: PASS harness completed: 62 checks, 61 positive, 1 product failure (UX-011), 0 blocked, 0 page errors
tests.limitation: Request counters in the JSON are per scenario and the final apiCalls field is only the last scenario aggregate; non-app traffic was blocked and app APIs used local fixtures.

tests.command: node --test intentgraph\network-execution.test.cjs intentgraph\sandbox-routes.test.cjs intentgraph\steering.test.cjs intentgraph\agent-runtime.test.cjs intentgraph\chat-runtime.test.cjs
tests.limitation: Unit tests cover runtime boundaries, not the full browser UI.

defects.title: Conversation rename overwrites coworker identity header
defects.repro: Open a chat, choose Rename conversation, save a new conversation title, and inspect the active header.
defects.expected: Sidebar conversation title changes while the coworker/profile identity header remains Firewall.
defects.actual: Active header changes to the renamed conversation title.
